manual_basis: Installed manual physical pp338-339 and 439-441 ties task-referenced ItemRepair activation to the referenced Tasks.TCID/TLID and the selected APID's MaintenanceAllocation station. The numeric TaskLevel.LEVL is not the task-level identifier.
controlled_design: Two task rows have identical neutral description, TLID BASE and empty NOTE; TID A=I01-LRU-DIRP is referenced by both station-specific one-hour ItemRepair rows, while TID B=I01-CATEGORY-B is inert. The two source layers swap only their two Tasks.TCID cells between LRU-CM and DECOY-CM, preserving TID references. Both APIDs allocate both categories with crossed stations: AIR_BASIC LRU-CM→BASE and DECOY-CM→DEPOT; AIR_DEPOT LRU-CM→DEPOT and DECOY-CM→BASE. Stock is BASE1/DEPOT0 under both APIDs. Four inputs cross source layer and APID; within a layer the pair changes only Control.APID and description, while within an APID the layer changes only two Tasks.TCID cells and description. No ItemReorder or ResourceAllocation business rows.

pre_run_hypotheses.common: All four runs should convert without error, reproduce the same first physical LRU ID1 failure h9.8829, base spare ID0 draw h10, aircraft readiness h10.5, and exact 24-table authored roundtrip. Any difference is diagnostic until explained.

pre_run_hypotheses.alternatives: The converter may reject the crossed category topology, the inert task, or a source layer; the engine may choose a different repair row or timing. Preserve contrary runs as diagnostics and do not publish positive category binding without all four matched physical traces and independent replay.

limits: This is a bounded category-aware task binding and APID interaction for one LRU, two category labels, two stations and one seed. The inert Task B is bookkeeping and does not model a competing live repair demand.
